title: Fourier-Laplace transforms in polynomial Ornstein-Uhlenbeck volatility models
abstract: arXiv:2405.02170v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We consider the Fourier-Laplace transforms of a broad class of polynomial Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) volatility models, including the well-known Stein-Stein, Sch\"obel-Zhu, one-factor Bergomi, and the recently introduced quintic OU models motivated by the SPX-VIX joint calibration problem. We show the connection between the joint Fourier-Laplace functional of the log-price and the integrated variance, and the solution of an infinite-dimensional system of Riccati equations. Next, under some non-vanishing conditions on the Fourier-Laplace transforms, we establish an existence result for such Riccati equations and show how the Fourier-Laplace functional can be seen as the limit of a sequence of entire functions. On the practical side, we develop a numerical scheme to solve the stiff infinite-dimensional system of Riccati equations and demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the scheme for pricing SPX options and volatility swaps using F

translated_title: 多项式Ornstein-Uhlenbeck波动率模型中的傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一大类多项式Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) 波动率模型的傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换，其中包括著名的Stein-Stein模型、Schöbel-Zhu模型、单因子Bergomi模型，以及受SPX-VIX联合校准问题启发而最近提出的五次OU模型。我们展示了其对数价格与积分方差的联合傅里叶-拉普拉斯泛函与无穷维Riccati方程组解之间的联系。其次，在傅里叶-拉普拉斯变换满足某些非消失性条件下，我们建立了此类Riccati方程组的存在性结果，并证明了傅里叶-拉普拉斯泛函可以看作一列整函数的极限。在实践方面，我们开发了一种数值格式来求解刚性无穷维Riccati方程组，并演示了该格式在利用傅里叶方法为SPX期权和波动率互换定价时的高效性与准确性。
tldr: 本文揭示了一类多项式Ornstein-Uhlenbeck波动率模型的傅里叶-拉普拉斯泛函与无穷维Riccati方程组解之间的联系，证明了该方程组的存在性结果，并开发了高效准确的数值求解方法用于SPX期权和波动率互换的定价。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the connection between the Fourier-Laplace functionals of polynomial Ornstein-Uhlenbeck volatility models and the solutions of infinite-dimensional Riccati systems, proves existence results for such systems, and develops an efficient and accurate numerical scheme for pricing SPX options and volatility swaps.
